**Reading notes:** extraction time = the adapter's whole `run()` call (document open, page load, text extraction) minus overlay construction. Startup (library import, adapter construction) and overlay times are separate and must not be added to it. Extraction CPU ms comes from `time.process_time()`, whose resolution on Windows is about 15.6 ms, so sub-15 ms values often show 0.00 and aren't meaningful at this scale. Timings come from one run per fixture on a laptop and are not a performance benchmark.
